title: Angels Landing, 1924: no chains, no switchbacks #Shorts
description:
In 1924 there were no chains and no Walter's Wiggles on the way up Angels Landing. A newspaper said the ridge narrowed from ten feet to ten inches. Own footage from our Zion trip.

Video: the channel's own footage from Zion (2021). Photos: Ken Lund (CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons); NPS, HABS/HAER, NARA and Hillers/Beaman (public domain); Zion Narrows stream (CC0).

▶ Full Zion documentary: https://youtu.be/ugASzW14E9s
